## Agivant AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

Agivant's demo profile focuses on practical AI adoption, workflow automation, and productivity use cases for enterprise teams.

## AI Product Launches
- Custom AI assistants: Workflow-specific assistants for sales, procurement, support, and operations
- Automation pilots: Proof-of-value projects for document processing and knowledge retrieval
- Analytics copilots: Natural language interfaces for business reporting and insights

## Productivity Updates
- Meeting and document summarization workflows
- Internal knowledge search and proposal drafting support
- Process automation for repetitive back-office tasks

## Enterprise Features
- Discovery workshops and ROI mapping
- Secure implementation patterns using customer-approved cloud environments
- Governance support for prompts, access controls, and human review
